title: hieracium pilosella proles peleterianum
intro: Hieracium pilosella proles peleterianum, commonly known as a subspecies of the Hawkweed plant, is a flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Hieracium pilosella proles peleterianum include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce pain, and fight infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects.
